# CPOP UNIVERSE

> > Official Chinese drama merchandise store featuring collectibles from popular C-dramas including Love in Pavilion, The First Frost, Love Game in Eastern Fantasy, and more.

CPOP UNIVERSE is a specialized retailer offering official merchandise from Chinese dramas and entertainment properties. The store carries licensed products from major platforms like Tencent, Youku, and collaborations with brands like PINPIN PLANET, HITCARD, and WUDOLL, featuring stars such as Zhang Linghe, Tian Xiwei, Esther Yu, and Allen Ren Jialun.

## Key Topics

- Chinese Drama Merchandise
- Official Licensed Collectibles
- Tencent Official Products
- Zhang Linghe
- Tian Xiwei
- Love in Pavilion
- The First Frost
- Love Game in Eastern Fantasy
- PINPIN PLANET Collaborations
- Acrylic Standees
- Character Keychains
- Photocards & Blind Boxes
- Plushie Dolls
- Drama-themed Accessories
- Pre-order Collectibles
